violations.text: Cheese was observed held between 44-52 degrees Fahrenheit in the open air unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Ambient of open air unit was observed at 39 DF. Cheese was observed pushed too far up-front, causing a rise in temperature. All food was evaluated and either voluntarily disposed of or pushed back to the colder part of unit. Establishment is to ensure that all food in the open air unit stays at 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

Knives were observed being stored in between the cracks of shelving. Knives were moved to 3-bay sink at the time of inspection. Proper utensil storage reviewed with PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026
The floor seal coating in the walk-in cooler area was observed peeling and in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

The floor in the back soda area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

At the time of inspection, the menu display board (tv) was observed off/not working. PIC is to provide a written allergen statement for customer viewing at the front counter food service area. (Allergen statement written at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2025

Pastry items packaged in the food establishment are lacking proper labels (observed labeled with the ingredients and allergens). Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients and allergens, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Packaged items observed lacking business name and address on labels. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2025

The doors to the outside, located in the backroom area and front main entrance, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. (Per the PIC, a work order is in place for repairs.) New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2025

The following areas of the physical facilities were observed in need of repair... - The sealed coating to the floor of the walk-in cooler was observed to be peeling in various areas exposing the cement floor. - The wall near the mop sink area was observed to be cracked/broken exposing inner wall materials. Per the PIC, work order is in place for facility wall repair(s) New Violation. Correct By: 01/31/2026
